summary.text: Stephanie Mack is a Republican candidate for the Vermont House of Representatives, Chittenden-24 District, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An Essex business owner and financial professional, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that her campaign focuses on lower taxes, property tax relief, housing and small businesses.

paragraphs.text: Mack said in a Ballotpedia survey that she has lived in Essex, Vermont, for 25 years, is married to Tim Mack, and has raised three children and been a foster parent to about half a dozen children.
She said she previously built and sold an accounting practice and helped establish back-office systems for her family's trash hauling business before its sale.

She said she now leads Strategizer LLC, which provides workflow consulting, app integrations, part-time CFO services and interim bookkeeping, and that she serves as treasurer of the Vermont Federation of Republican Women.

Mack said her campaign emphasizes auditing state spending, property tax relief, streamlining permitting to increase housing, reducing regulatory burdens on small businesses, parental rights in education, and election integrity.
She said she would support a statewide e-permitting system for residential and mixed-income projects.
